difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the descent of an impurity to a stage of a directed limit of affine schemes at source lines 318-326, label lemma-impure-limit, whose proof occupies source lines 328-360. The proof proceeds in two independent steps: it first uses base change of the relative assassin to verify that the projected point remains an associated point of the base changed module, reducing the claim to the closure condition, and then handles the closure condition by realising the closures of the chosen points over the stages as a directed limit, taking the fibre over the given point of the base, and observing that this fibre is empty at the limit but quasi-compact at each stage, so that the nonemptiness criterion for limits of quasi-compact spaces produces a stage where the fibre is already empty. The counted statement records neither the relative assassin step nor the limit criterion.
